Zsh is the default shell for quarto-term. No special configuration is needed.

```yaml
extensions:
  term:
    shell: zsh
```

For syntax highlighting, add [zsh-syntax-highlighting](https://github.com/zsh-users/zsh-syntax-highlighting) to `init`:

```yaml
extensions:
  term:
    init:
      - zsh-syntax-highlighting
```

## Basic Usage

```{term}
echo "Hello from $ZSH_NAME $ZSH_VERSION"
```

## Associative Arrays

```{term}
typeset -A fruits
fruits=(apple red banana yellow cherry pink)
for k v in ${(kv)fruits}; do print "$k is $v"; done
```

## Glob Qualifiers

```{term}
mkdir -p /tmp/zsh-demo && cd /tmp/zsh-demo
touch file1.txt file2.txt script.sh
chmod +x script.sh
print -l *(.)
```

## Parameter Expansion

```{term}
words="hello world foo bar"
print ${(U)words}
print ${(ws: :)words}
```

```{term}
#| include: false
rm -rf /tmp/zsh-demo
```
